quarterly_data.quarter: Sugon results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Li Jun (results briefing), management view on domestic AI compute: downstream customers choosing domestic compute weigh supply-chain security, ecosystem adaptation and total cost of use; domestic large models adapting deeply to local compute is now the mainstream trend. The company keeps building out a domestic self-controlled supply chain, stays compatible with multiple chip routes, and plans to deepen ecosystem cooperation with leading large-model makers with customised training-and-inference solutions. He names its core differentiators as large-scale compute-cluster construction, advanced liquid-cooling energy saving, high-speed interconnect architecture and full-stack hardware and software services.
